customManagers.description: The kubernetes/flux managers above extract chart versions and top-level manifest images, but not images nested inside arbitrary HelmRelease values (e.g. an initContainer) - this tracks Headlamp's pinned Flux plugin image tag explicitly so it isn't silently missed.
